name: Send Daily Clinic List

on:
  schedule:
    # Runs every day at 8:00 AM UTC
    - cron: '0 8 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch: # Allows you to trigger the email manually anytime from GitHub

jobs:
  build-and-send:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Run daily clinic script
        env:
          EMAIL_USER: ${{ secrets.EMAIL_USER }}
          EMAIL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EMAIL_PASSWORD }}
          RECIPIENT_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.RECIPIENT_EMAIL }}
        run: |
          python send_clinics.py
